verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and texting platform, so auto-replies and scheduled texts are a fair question. However, the evidence never documents text auto-replies, missed-call text-back, after-hours SMS replies, or scheduled messages. The closest items are Sona, an AI agent that 'answers when your team can't', and MCP/API features for sending texts and viewing missed calls. These are adjacent capabilities and do not show automated or scheduled text replies.
